subject.title: fix(mac-gateway): write launchd stderr to a log file and surface it in diagnostics (#90711)

question: After fixing the active-writer data-loss bug, should macOS launchd stderr ship with periodic plist-write capping, or wait for continuously bounded retention?
rationale: The mechanical race is repairable, but accepting unbounded growth between operator actions is an operations and compatibility choice that cannot be inferred safely from the patch.

options.title: Require continuous retention
options.body: Restore stderr only with a lifecycle-owned design that bounds unattended KeepAlive relaunch loops.

options.title: Accept periodic capping
options.body: Land a writer-safe plist-write cap while explicitly accepting growth between installs or restarts.

options.title: Keep stderr suppressed
options.body: Defer file-backed stderr until the broader retention implementation is ready.

recommendation.title: Require continuous retention
recommendation.body: Restore stderr only with a lifecycle-owned design that bounds unattended KeepAlive relaunch loops.
